purpose: Shared camera initializer before feedback A/B, not a performance arm or ground truth
readiness_rule: One connected reconstruction with all six predeclared frames registered and at least 100 triangulated points
geometric_threshold_policy: Keep installed 4.2.0 geometric defaults; serialize effective options in every result
unregistered_frame_policy: Retain missing IDs and fail initialization readiness; no resampling or per-frame best-model stitching
coordinate_policy: Arbitrary SfM similarity gauge. No inferred metric scale or gravity alignment is declared measured.
